Make use of the following modals in sentence as asked in brackets. 10   
i) Can. (To offer someone something)   
ii) Shall. (To propose someone for something in interrogative form)   
iii) Should. (To express natural inference)   
iv) Could. (To express past permanentability)   
v) Will. (To express a polite request)
